verdict.rationale: Bolna's own docs say TTS providers can be connected from Settings → Integrations, that it supports Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs and more, and that users can choose different voices, accents and speaking styles. That establishes multi-provider TTS plug-in and voice selection. However, there is no evidence of the size or breadth of the voice library and no hands-on corroboration, so this is partial rather than full coverage. missing for 10: evidence of a broad voice library (voice count or catalog), an explicit list of supported TTS providers rather than a mixed STT/TTS list, per-agent TTS provider and voice configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want

citations.quote: Every provider you can bring to Bolna — telephony, LLM, TTS, STT and tools — is connected from a single place in the dashboard: Settings → Integrations.
Bolna supports Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs, and more.
You can choose different voices, accents, and speaking styles to match your brand.
When you bring your own keys (BYOK), Bolna does not charge for those components.
